title: satk.util.audioFile~
description: `satk.util.audioFile~` is a flexible audio-file player that loads files into an array, supports looping, normalization, selectable start and end points, and variable-speed playback; it can also load raw data files for data bending or sonification. Send a bang to play the loaded file, and set playback speed from 0.1 to 500, where 100 is normal, lower values are faster, and higher values are slower.
